name: harness-minimal-agent
description: Minimal AgentPM Harness starter that installs one published Agent package and runs it through the reference Harness TUI or headless CLI.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Generated project name. Generation-time only; do not use for API keys, tokens, passwords, or runtime secrets.

variables.name: workspace_label
variables.description: Human-readable label shown in the generated README and Harness TUI header.

variables.name: default_user_scope
variables.description: Default local user scope value used by the sample Harness config.

variables.name: default_repository_scope
variables.description: Default local repository scope value used by the sample Harness config.

variables.name: openai_model
variables.description: Default OpenAI model identifier used by agentpm.harness.json. Set credentials at runtime, not as a template variable.

variables.name: ollama_model
variables.description: Default local Ollama model identifier used by agentpm.ollama.harness.json.

entrypoints.label: Export local env for this shell
Run one headless prompt
entrypoints.command: agentpm harness --headless --input "Review this generated workspace and summarize what the installed Agent can do." --report reports/first-run.json
